jobs.title: Product Owner Finance
jobs.description:
About Weezevent
 From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats.
 We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control , CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world.
 Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year.
 Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy).
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Product Vision and Strategy : execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands.
 Stakeholder Collaboration : act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features. 
Detect and report payments incidents when impacting organizers appreciation.
Communicate the product vision and strategy effectively to stakeholders and team members.
Provide operational support to the Client success and Finance teams. Providing help for PSP configurations, responding to questions in Slack, triaging RUN requests and generating custom exports is key for the well functioning of the company.
 Product Backlog Management : create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements.
Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.
 Development and Delivery : work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines. 
Review, QA and accept completed user stories to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria and deliver the expected value.
 Market and User Research : analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology.
 Compliance and Risk Management : ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with financial products and solutions with a strong emphasis on compliance and regulatory adherence.
 Performance Monitoring : monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators. 
Implement changes and improvements based on performance metrics and user feedback.
 
 Why it's a good move ? 
You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance.
 
 Fundamentals to join us :
 You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ; 

 You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory.

 You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

 You speak French fluently.

 Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk !
 All of our positions are open to people with disabilities. 
 Compensation and benefits
 We offer a salary of EUR 50,400–65,000 per year for this permanent contract based in Clichy with a hybrid working arrangement. Private health insurance is provided to cover your medical needs. Public transportation benefits support your daily commute. Paid sick leave ensures you have time to recover when needed. Home Office options offer flexibility in your weekly schedule. A casual dress code allows you to wear what makes you comfortable at work. Regular team events and social activities keep you connected with colleagues.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Accounting (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mach aus komplexer Buchhaltungssoftware eine, die Menschen ihre Arbeit leichter macht. 
 Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Dadurch sind wir direkt an den Menschen, Prozessen und Problemen, für die wir bauen.
 Buchhaltung ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Arbeit. Ob Mietausschüttung, Unterkonten oder Jahresabrechnung: Abläufe müssen verständlich, Ergebnisse korrekt und Automatisierungen auch dann zuverlässig sein, wenn etwas vom Standardfall abweicht.
 Wir suchen jemanden, der Buchhaltung tief versteht und dieses Wissen in bessere Software übersetzen kann. Gemeinsam mit unseren Nutzern, Engineering und Design findest du heraus, welche Probleme wir lösen müssen, wie eine gute Lösung aussieht und wohin sich unser Accounting-Produkt entwickeln soll.
 Was du bei uns machst
 Probleme wirklich verstehen: Du arbeitest dich in die Buchhaltungsprozesse unserer Hausverwaltungen ein – inklusive Sonderfällen, fachlichen Anforderungen und bestehender Einschränkungen.

 Die richtigen Verbesserungen identifizieren: Du unterscheidest zwischen fehlenden Funktionen, unklaren Abläufen, technischen Fehlern und Fragen zur Bedienung.

 Die Produktrichtung gestalten: Du entwickelst eine klare Vorstellung davon, wie Accounting bei Buena funktionieren soll, und priorisierst Verbesserungen nach Nutzen, fachlicher Notwendigkeit und Wirkung.

 Lösungen konkret machen: Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in verständliche Konzepte, Spezifikationen und Nutzerabläufe, die du mit Engineering und Design weiterentwickelst.

 Korrektheit sicherstellen: Du prüfst Lösungen, denkst Sonderfälle durch und beurteilst, ob neue Funktionen die zugrunde liegenden Anforderungen erfüllen.

 Bis zur Nutzung dranbleiben: Du begleitest Verbesserungen bis zur Einführung und überprüfst, ob sie das ursprüngliche Problem im Alltag lösen.

 Das kann eine gezielte Verbesserung bei Mietausschüttungen sein – oder die grundlegende Weiterentwicklung unserer Kontenstruktur.
 Was du mitbringst
 Tiefes Buchhaltungsverständnis: Du kannst Abläufe erklären und erkennst, wenn etwas fachlich fehlt oder nicht stimmt. Erfahrung in der Immobilien- oder WEG-Buchhaltung ist besonders wertvoll.

 Produktdenken: Du hinterfragst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, unterscheidest echte Anforderungen von Gewohnheiten und entwickelst Ideen für bessere Abläufe.

 Analytische Stärke: Du zerlegst komplexe Probleme, vergleichst Lösungswege und erkennst, welcher nächste Schritt den größten Nutzen bringt.

 Technische Neugier: Du möchtest verstehen, wie unsere Software funktioniert, und kannst Anforderungen und Abwägungen mit Engineers diskutieren.

 Klare Kommunikation und Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Fachlichkeit, Nutzerperspektive und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bleibst an einer Lösung, bis sie praktisch funktioniert.

 Besonders relevant ist Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung oder Verbesserung von Buchhaltungssoftware. Dein bisheriger Jobtitel ist dabei zweitrangig: Entscheidend ist, dass du Buchhaltung verstehst und daraus sinnvolle Softwarelösungen ableiten kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Recherche, Prototypen oder Tests ist ein Plus.
 Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest
 Dein Fachwissen verändert das Produkt: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die unsere Software nutzen, und siehst, was deine Entscheidungen im Alltag bewirken.

 Du ergänzt ein starkes Team: Engineering und Design bringen ihre Expertise ein. Gemeinsam könnt ihr Probleme von der fachlichen Ursache bis zur fertigen Lösung bearbeiten.

 Deine Ergebnisse schaffen Möglichkeiten: Wir wachsen schnell und geben Menschen Verantwortung, die etwas bewegen.

 Du baust langfristig mit: Unsere Mission ist, Wohneigentum zugänglicher zu machen. Gute Software und funktionierende Hausverwaltungen bilden dafür die Grundlage.

 Deine Benefits
 Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro.

 Verpflegung: 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget.

 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  
 This Role Is Not For 
 People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

 PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

 Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

 People who launch features and then stop caring.

 PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

  
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany. 
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche.

Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sie als (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d) . 
 
 Was Sie bei uns bewegen: 
 Permanente Durchführung von Passform- und Qualitätskontrollen

 Produktionsfreigabe anhand Mustertypen

 Kontinuierlicher Austausch innerhalb des Produktmanagements und mit den internationalen Produktionsstätten
 

 Was uns ausmacht: 
 Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur.

 Alles, was Sie zum Arbeiten benötigen: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung.

 Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Sie gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle können Sie Ihr Berufsleben optimal an ihr Privatleben anpassen.

 Mit uns profitieren Sie von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern über das Portal corporate Benefits.

 Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine.

 Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Ihr Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße.

 Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de.

 Wir feiern Erfolg und Gemeinschaft: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Team-Events und Firmenfeiern sind ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur.

 
 Was Sie ausmacht: 
 Schuhgröße 37, Fußlänge 231 – 236 mm, durchschnittliche Fuß- und Wadenform

 Großes Interesse an Mode und Schuhen sowie ein starkes Bewusstsein für die Qualität von Materialien und deren Verarbeitung

 Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit gepaart mit guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift

 Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung wünschenswert; gerne auch Quereinsteiger

 Hohes Engagement 

 Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen

 
 Sie sind ein verantwortungsbewusster und äußerst engagierter Teamplayer und schätzen die konstruktive Zusammenarbeit? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

 Gülizar Yüsün

Internationale Schuhproduktionen

32758 Detmold

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Le rôle
 Wink développe des solutions technologiques et recherche un Growth Product Manager pour piloter l'acquisition, la conversion et la rétention sur nos plateformes depuis notre bureau parisien en mode hybride. Vous concevez, testez et déployez des stratégies d'optimisation de nos tunnels de croissance en analysant en continu les indicateurs de performance clés.
 Vos missions
 Identifier les leviers d'accélération et concevoir des expériences utilisateur orientées sur la conversion.

 Mettre en place des campagnes de tests A/B rigoureuses pour valider les hypothèses d'optimisation.

 Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques, design et marketing pour aligner les initiatives produit sur les objectifs de croissance.

 Analyser les données d'utilisation pour identifier les points de friction et les opportunités d'amélioration du parcours utilisateur.

 Ce que nous recherchons
 Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de produits orientés croissance au sein d'environnements technologiques.

 Maîtrise des outils d'analyse de données et des méthodologies de test A/B.

 Capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour livrer des fonctionnalités à fort impact.

 Rigueur analytique et orientation prononcée vers les résultats mesurables.

 Rémunération et avantages
 La rémunération proposée pour ce poste en CDI à temps partiel ou complet de 35h par semaine est de EUR 4,500–6,000 per month.
 Vous bénéficiez d'une adhésion à un club de sport ainsi que d'une option de co-working payant.
 Premiers mois
 Dès vos premiers mois chez Wink, vous aurez pris en main l'analyse de nos tunnels de conversion actuels et lancé vos premiers tests A/B pour optimiser l'acquisition. Vous aurez également initié des collaborations étroites avec l'équipe technique pour aligner nos priorités de croissance.
 Si vous vous reconnaissez dans la majorité de ces exigences sans les cocher toutes, nous vous encourageons vivement à postuler.

jobs.title: Founding lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. 

 We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. 

 We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies.

 Tasks

 User Research & Discovery 

 
 Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.

 Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.

 Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.

 Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

 
  

 Product & Experience Design 

 
 What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.

 Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.

 Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.

 Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.

 Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot.

 Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them.

 
 Requirements

 
 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products.

 A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped.

 A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction.

 Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

 We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner , with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 
 We are a certified B Corporation , upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society. 
 
 Our values ✨ 
 Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: 
 Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. 

 Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. 

 Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. 

 
 The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 
 UpSlide is a productivity platform for Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel and Word) built for financial professionals in investment banking, private equity, asset management and advisory. Product Marketing sits at the centre of Product, Sales and Marketing: we decide how UpSlide is positioned, priced and sold.
 You'll join as our Head of Product Marketing, reporting directly to Matteo Bordin , our Chief Product Officer.
 You'll manage one PMM and over time grow your team.
 Day-to-day, you'll work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing leadership. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and still get into the work. 
 
 Team goals 🎯 
 Product Marketing's job is to make UpSlide easy to understand, easy to sell, and priced right. Concretely, that means:
 Sharpen positioning and messaging so prospects grasp the value fast.

 Arm Sales to win, especially against direct competitors.

 Run customer communications that drive adoption and expansion.

 The impact on the business is direct: higher win rates, stronger pricing power, shorter sales cycles.
 
 Your responsibilities 🖋️ 
 Positioning & narrative (25%)

 Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. 670 000+ membres, un produit régulé (PSFP) et une même exigence sur toute l’expérience : permettre d’investir simplement mais aussi de suivre son investissement dans la durée.

 Bricks est une plateforme à deux faces : d’un côté les investisseurs , de l’autre les porteurs de projets immobiliers . Deux communautés à accompagner et faire grandir en parallèle. 

 Ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet compte donc autant que le moment où l’on investit : qualité de l’information, transparence, suivi des projets et gestion des situations plus complexes participent directement à l’expérience des deux côtés de la plateforme.

 Quelques jalons d’une aventure assez unique : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée : 5 M€ en 5 secondes, 20 M€+ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

 Côté business : 176 M€ collectés en 2025, +90 % en un an et la rentabilité atteinte. Notre prochain enjeu : scaler à grande échelle sans perdre la vélocité qui fait aujourd’hui partie de notre manière de travailler.

 Chez Bricks, on attend de chacun qu’il comprenne vraiment les problèmes avant de chercher à les résoudre. L’objectif : prendre les bonnes décisions et construire des solutions utiles. 

 Sur ce poste, ton travail aura un impact direct sur la qualité du suivi des projets et sur la confiance des investisseurs comme des porteurs de projets.

 C’est aussi ce qui fait de la gestion post-financement l’un des sujets les plus stratégiques pour Bricks . Une plateforme d’investissement ne se construit pas uniquement au moment où un utilisateur décide d’investir : elle se construit dans la durée, dans la qualité du suivi et dans la façon dont les situations plus complexes sont prises en charge.

 Le challenge n’est pas simplement de “gérer 400 projets”. Il est de construire un système capable d’en gérer demain beaucoup plus sans faire grossir l’équipe au même rythme.

 Une plateforme existe déjà et accompagne l’équipe au quotidien. Elle a atteint un niveau de maturité où les prochains problèmes ne se résoudront pas uniquement avec de nouvelles features : parfois la meilleure réponse sera produit, parfois process, parfois automatisation, parfois juridique.

 C’est là que tu interviens.

 Comprendre profondément le quotidien des utilisateurs internes en particulier celui de la personne qui opère nos projets au quotidien : observer, écouter, identifier les irritants et comprendre ce qui peut être supprimé, automatisé ou mieux structuré.

 Faire évoluer la gestion de plusieurs centaines de projets pour qu’elle reste fluide et scalable : priorisation, automatisation, workflows, process et outils.

 Travailler avec l’engineering pour transformer les problèmes identifiés en solutions produit lorsqu’une solution technique est pertinente.

 Aller chercher l’information là où elle se trouve : care, juridique, marketing, métier, engineering… Tu ne travailles pas à partir d’une spec parfaite, tu reconstruis toi-même le contexte.

 T’approprier des sujets parfois complexes ou réglementaires. Tu n’as pas besoin d’être juriste, mais un contrat de 50 pages ou une discussion sur un process de contentieux ne doit pas te faire fuir.

 Choisir le bon levier plutôt que la feature par défaut : modifier un process peut parfois avoir plus d’impact que développer un nouvel écran.

 Transformer chaque problème rencontré en apprentissage réutilisable : l’objectif n’est pas de traiter le problème du projet n°237, mais de faire en sorte qu’il soit mieux géré pour les centaines de projets suivants.

 Et progressivement, prendre de plus en plus d’ownership sur la stratégie et la roadmap de la squad . Le périmètre pourra évoluer fortement selon ce que tu démontres sur le terrain.

 Tu travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes en charge du suivi opérationnel des projets ainsi qu’avec l'Engineering, le Product, le Growth et Marketing.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
jobs.description:
Your Role
 As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't.
 
 What you'll do
 End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.

 Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

 Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories.

 Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance.

 Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID.

 
 What you bring
 Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus.

 Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one.

 Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster.

 Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase.

 Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization.

 
 What we offer 
 Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

 Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

 Appreciation : You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

 Development : We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

 Smart Money : As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms

 Chez HopLunch, nous proposons tous les midis une sélection de plats cuisinés avec amour par nos restaurateurs partenaires, le tout livré directement au bureau par notre équipe de supers livreurs. La recette parfaite pour une pause conviviale entre collègues ! Parce qu’un bon repas, c’est bien plus qu’une simple pause : c’est un moment de partage.

 Une équipe solidaire et dynamique 💪

 Une startup éco-responsable et pleine d’ambition 🍃

 Une aventure humaine et culinaire, où chaque bouchée crée du lien ! 🥗

 
 Si tu veux rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de son projet, c’est le moment de nous rejoindre pour partager le goût du local ! 🚀

 Prise de poste : janvier 2027

 Vos missions

 Tes missions : 

 En tant que Product Owner, tu joues un rôle pivot au sein de HopLunch. Sous la responsabilité de la Direction, vous êtes responsable de la bonne exécution de la roadmap produit et le lien indispensable entre les utilisateurs, les services Holding (Customer Care, Marketing, Sales, etc.) et l'équipe de développement.

 Ta mission est de maximiser la valeur du produit livré tout en assurant l'excellence opérationnelle chère à notre culture.

 1. Stratégie et Vision Produit 

 
 Définir et porter la vision du produit à court et moyen terme en accord avec les objectifs de croissance de l'entreprise.

 Identifier et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs internes pour proposer des fonctionnalités pertinentes.

 Assurer une veille concurrentielle sur le secteur de la FoodTech et de la logistique mutualisée.

 
 2. Gestion du Product Backlog 

 
 Rédiger les User Stories détaillées, claires et sans ambiguïté pour l'équipe technique, facilement interprétable par l’IA.

 Prioriser le backlog en fonction de la valeur métier, des retours clients, des retours terrains et des contraintes techniques.

 Maintenir un backlog sain et ordonné pour garantir une visibilité sur les prochains développements.

 Découper les fonctionnalités en incréments livrables.

 Arbitrer les priorités en lien avec les enjeux business et techniques.

 
 3. Coordination et Pilotage Agile 

 
 Préparer les sprints, organiser et animer les rituels agiles : Sprints (généralement de 2 semaines), planifications et rétrospectives.

 Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe de développement pour lever les doutes fonctionnels et valider les livrables.

 Répondre aux questions fonctionnelles de l’équipe pendant le développement.

 Valider les livrables avant leur mise en production en effectuant les tests fonctionnels.

 
 4. Analyse et Amélioration Continue 

 
 Suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPIs) liés à l'adoption des fonctionnalités et à l'engagement utilisateur (actuellement 18 000 utilisateurs actifs/mois).

 Recueillir régulièrement les feedbacks des parties prenantes pour adapter le produit de manière itérative.

 Participer à l’évolution des méthodes produit de HopLunch.

 
 Vos compétences

 Ce que nous te demandons : 

 Expérience :

 
 Minimum 2 ans d’expérience comme Product Owner ou Product Manager dans une startup ou une entreprise technologique en forte croissance.

 Expérience concrète dans un environnement Agile (Scrum ou Kanban).

 Vous avez déjà travaillé en proximité avec une équipe de développement.

 
 Compétences techniques :

 
 Maîtrise des méthodologies Agiles (Scrum).

 Excellentes capacités de priorisation.

 Bonne compréhension des problématiques techniques pour dialoguer efficacement avec les développeurs.

 Une connaissance SQL est un vrai plus.

 Culture produit orientée utilisateur.

 Très bonnes qualités rédactionnelles pour des spécifications fonctionnelles et des User Stories claires.

 Aisance avec les outils de gestion de projet (Asana), de communication (Teams), de prise de notes et organisation de travail (Notion), outils d’analyse produit (Hotjar, Google Analytics ou équivalent) et IA (Claude, ChatGPT).

 
 Qualités personnelles :

 
 L’exigence, pour porter une attention particulière aux détails et au travail bien fait.

 Tu as un bon sens de la communication, pour échanger avec des profils variés (commerciaux, techniques, direction).

 Tu as une vision business et technique pour prioriser les sujets qui apportent le plus de valeur pour un minimum d’effort.

 Tu sais défendre tes choix de priorisation tout en restant à l'écoute des remarques potentielles.

 L’agilité d'esprit pour évoluer dans un environnement startup en forte croissance !

 
 Avantages

 Ce que nous t'offrons : 

 
 Repas du midi pris en charge à 100% (promis, tu vas te régaler 🍜)

 Mutuelle prise en charge à 100%

 Equipements sportifs disponibles

 2 jours de congés supplémentaires par an offerts

 Télétravail ponctuel

 Rémunération variable en fonction de tes missions et objectifs

 Un environnement stimulant auprès d’u

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.
 We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.
 Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.
 Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.
 Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.
 The Problem You'll Solve 
 Prosus is building an AI-first future across a global portfolio that spans food delivery, e-commerce, fintech, and education. We invest over $100 million annually in AI, run 800+ models in production, and have deployed Toqan — our internal platform for building, testing, and deploying GenAI and agentic workflows — across the organisation. The scale of ambition is real; the challenge now is focus, coherence, and velocity.
 As Group Product Manager for our AI Platform, you will own the multi-year product strategy for the platform that underpins every AI initiative across Prosus. This means defining and sequencing the roadmap for agent infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, model deployment pipelines, and the shared capabilities that internal teams — from applied science to application engineering — rely on to build and ship AI products. You will balance long-term platform investments against the immediate, high-impact needs of teams across the portfolio who are racing to deliver.
 You will lead and mentor a team of product managers, instilling product discipline and building the PM talent pipeline that scales with the platform. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science leadership to shape the technical strategy — making the hard trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and reliability that determine what we can promise the business.
 And you will be the connective tissue: the person who turns ambiguous, fast-moving business needs into clear requirements, who aligns stakeholders across functions and geographies, and who ensures that what we build is not just technically impressive but adopted, trusted, and measurably impactful.
 
 Who You Are 
 You are a senior product leader who has lived through the messy reality of building platform products for internal teams — and loved it. You measure your success not by features shipped but by the velocity and quality of the teams who build on top of your platform.
 
 You are deeply technical. You can engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on model lifecycle, MLOps, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure trade-offs — not as a bystander, but as a thought partner. You understand agentic architectures, LLM capabilities and limitations, and the operational realities of running AI in production at scale.
 
 You are a people leader. You have managed and mentored product managers, and you take genuine pride in their growth. You set strategic direction, coordinate overlapping roadmaps into a coherent plan, and create the clarity that lets your team operate with autonomy and purpose.
 
 You thrive in ambiguity. You have worked in fast-paced, high-scale environments where priorities shift and the path forward is not always clear. You do not wait for perfect information — you run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and let data and user feedback guide the next step.
 
 You are a communicator. You can simplify complex technical concepts for executive leadership one hour and dig into detailed requirements with an engineering team the next. You build trust across functions and geographies, and you are as comfortable pushing back as you are building consensus.
 
 You are customer-obsessed — even when your customers are internal teams. You connect frequently with the people who use your platform, validate solutions through product discovery, and treat adoption as a first-class metric.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

 Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

 What You'll Be Doing 

 You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 
 Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

 Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

 Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

 Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

 
 What You'll Need to Thrive 

 Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

 
 Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

 You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

 You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

 You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

 You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

 You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

 
 Next steps

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Verve is a global ad-tech company that owns and operates a fully integrated advertising stack, spanning demand, supply, and data. While most companies in our space specialize in one layer of the ecosystem, we own the DSP, the SSP, and the data and identity infrastructure that connects them. This means our technology works end to end, in real time, every time a user opens an app or loads a screen.


We reach 2.5 billion consumers across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Our platform processes billions of signals daily, enabling advertisers to plan and execute campaigns with precision and publishers to manage and monetize their inventory effectively. As the digital advertising landscape shifts away from walled gardens and third-party identifiers, Verve is focused on building the infrastructure that supports a more open, accountable internet. That is what drives the work we do.


About the Position
We are seeking a results-driven Senior Product Manager / Product Manager to own key commercial and technical areas of Verve’s core programmatic Marketplace. In this role you will lead cross-functional product execution alongside engineering, yield, commercial, and operations teams. You will be responsible for moving product initiatives from intake to structured execution, driving measurable improvements in our marketplace performance, publisher yield, and DSP spend velocity. Depending on your background and expertise, you will take ownership of one of our core exchange focus areas.


Position Responsibilities
● Product Strategy & Execution: Own feature discovery, product requirements (PRDs), user stories, and clearly define the acceptance criteria.
● Commercial Prioritization: Apply prioritization models, to prioritize you team's backlogs based on revenue impact, margin protection, and operational efficiency.
● Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner directly with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers to transition squad prior from technical hygiene to commercial ROI.
● Performance Analytics: Monitor exchange KPIs to identify revenue challenges, new feature issues or new growth opportunities.
● Product Release Management: Lead release cycles across cross-functional teams, ensuring clear documentation, enablement, and internal communication


What Success Looks Like
● Clear, commercially prioritized backlog in Jira driven by business ROI rather than reactive tech tasks.
● Delivery of high-impact exchange features that unblock buyer spend, improve yield, or streamline publisher onboarding.
● Seamless cross-functional alignment between Engineering Tech Leads, Product Leadership, Commercials teams and Yield Ops.


Position Requirements
● Experience: 2+ years (Product Manager) or 4+ years (Senior Product Manager) of hands-on product management experience in Programmatic Advertising (SSPs, Ad Exchanges, DSPs, or Ad Servers).
● Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of OpenRTB protocols, RTB auction mechanics, supply chain transparency and digital ad formats.
● Operational experience: Demonstrated experience using structured prioritization frameworks (e.g., RICE) and Agile development methodologies.
● Analytical Skills: Strong ability to interpret high-volume bidstream insights into tangible feature plans.
● Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
● Optional skills (A plus): Mobile apps monetization SDK, Platform insights and analytics dashboards, mobile / web ad server technologies, Campaign management UI/UX experience.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management and IT Operations
jobs.description:
About Self Bill Pro: 
 Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities. 
 
 About the Role: Compensation - $130,000 - 160,000
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Product Management and IT Operations to lead the strategic direction and operational execution of our proprietary software platform. This is a critical leadership role that requires a unique blend of product management expertise, technical acumen, and operational leadership. You will be responsible for defining and driving the product roadmap while also ensuring the stability and security of our IT infrastructure and systems. 
 Reports to: Chief Operating Officer 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Product Leadership: Partner with our global product manager to define, prioritize, and manage the product roadmap, ensuring it aligns with overall business objectives and our long-term technology vision. 

 Product Development: Lead the product development lifecycle from ideation to launch, including gathering and analyzing user feedback, writing detailed user stories and specifications, and collaborating with our offshore software development team. 

 Technical Oversight: Provide technical oversight and guidance to the development team on product features, enhancements, and operational issues. 

 Compliance & Security: Ensure compliance with security standards (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA) and best practices, working to protect the organizationâs data and systems. 

 Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate with and manage relationships with various stakeholders, including customers, investors, and internal teams to gather requirements, test ideas, and communicate product progress. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the stateside operational team to field feedback and translate business needs into technical requirements. 

 IT Operations & Helpdesk: Oversee day-to-day IT operations, including helpdesk support and quick resolution of operational issues and hotfixes as new employees are onboarded. 

 
 Extensive experience in a product management role, with a strong background in software development and project management. 

 Direct experience in the employee benefits or benefits administration technology space is a must. 

 Proven ability to think creatively about building software solutions and features that solve complex, real-world problems. 

 Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 Experience managing and collaborating with a global or offshore development team. 

 Practical knowledge of IT operations, helpdesk support, and cybersecurity principles. 

 Familiarity with SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance requirements is highly desirable. 

 A natural leader with the ability to inspire and motivate a team, foster a positive work environment, and manage a high-volume workload in a fast-paced environment. 

 Why Join Us? At Self Bill Pro, youâll join a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to transforming outdated processes through smart, scalable technology. As a key leader in a rapidly growing organization, you will have a direct impact on our product, our clients, and our future. If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for technology, data, and making a tangible difference in the employee benefits landscape, we encourage you to apply! 
 Equal Opportunity Self Bill Pro is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.

You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. In this role, you will balance deep customer empathy with product discipline—translating complex operational requirements into repeatable core platform capabilities while establishing clear extension points for Professional Services.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Conduct deep-dive discovery with high-security enterprise and government stakeholders to understand their operational realities, using those insights to set clear, defensible product priorities.
  • Define and structure the explicit, phased customer journey framework—establishing the operational models, readiness criteria, and governance standards for initial platform installation, joint-operations training, and the final transition into fully autonomous, customer-operated environments with zero or limited vendor access.
  • Translate customer operational and security requirements into clear technical specifications for Core Infrastructure and Engineering teams with detail-oriented accuracy. Synthesizes underlying commonalities across clients who describe similar operational needs using different language, preventing costly, redundant engineering effort.
  • Define standardized building blocks that allow the core platform to extend safely into varying edge and air-gapped environments without hardcoding custom variants for every deployment.
  • Define clear boundaries for what belongs in the core platform versus what can be customized. Design clear hooks and interfaces so Professional Services and integration partners can build custom extensions without modifying core platform code.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of relevant work experience in Technical Product Management focusing on enterprise platforms, hybrid cloud deployments, or complex infrastructure products.
  • Ability to sit down with enterprise or government clients, listen to complex operational workflows, and identify the root problem behind divergent customer terminology.
  • Track record productizing cloud-native software platforms to deploy into customer-managed infrastructure, enterprise VPCs, or air-gapped data centers.
  • Ability to apply conceptual understanding of enterprise hybrid patterns similar to AWS Outposts, Azure Stack, Kubernetes-based enterprise distribution platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift), or infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g., HashiCorp Terraform/Vault).
  • Experience setting clear boundaries between core platform roadmap items and custom extensions delivered by Professional Services.
  • Detail-oriented mindset capable of mapping out complex operational transitions, training milestones, and access handoffs.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Prior experience navigating European sovereign cloud frameworks, regional data residency mandates, or EU defense/government compliance standards.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Search & Ranking
jobs.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your mission

Every Product Manager at Catawiki owns a meaningful part of the customer experience.

In Search and Ranking, your mission is to help buyers find the special objects they care about. You will shape how search, ranking and personalisation work across the buyer journey, making discovery more relevant and helping more buyers find objects they love.

This is a broad product area. It brings together buyer needs, expert curation, marketplace priorities, search experiences and machine learning. You will identify the most important opportunities, set a clear direction and lead a cross functional team from insight to measurable customer and business impact.

The solution is not prescribed. You may improve search relevance, ranking, recommendations or personalisation, or explore new AI enabled ways to help buyers discover objects. What matters is that you solve a meaningful customer problem, measure the impact and scale what works.

You will own the strategy, outcomes and execution for this area, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Commercial teams.

What you will do

  1. Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Search and Ranking.
  2. Own measurable outcomes across search relevance, discovery, engagement and buyer conversion.
  3. Use behavioural data, customer research and commercial insight to identify and prioritise the biggest opportunities.
  4. Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, prototypes and executable plans.
  5. Lead initiatives from early discovery through experimentation, launch and scaling.
  6. Define success metrics and build a rigorous experimentation agenda for search, ranking and personalisation.
  7. Work with machine learning engineers and data scientists to assess model quality, test new approaches and improve customer outcomes.
  8. Improve the relevance of search results and recommendations across the buyer journey.
  9. Integrate personalisation into the customer experience in ways that feel useful, coherent and trustworthy.
  10. Design, run and evaluate experiments, using positive, negative and inconclusive results to guide decisions.
  11. Use AI and rapid prototyping to test ideas early, reduce development risk and accelerate learning.
  12. Create clarity, momentum and accountability across teams, including when priorities or incentives differ.
  13. Communicate strategy, performance, tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to senior and C level stakeholders.

Who you are

Three qualities matter most in this role.

Outcome ownership

You take responsibility for customer and business results, not only for delivering features. You stay with the problem, remove obstacles and change direction when the evidence calls for it.

Systems thinking

You understand how search, ranking, recommendations, auction dynamics, expert curation and marketplace health influence one another. You make thoughtful decisions across the full buyer journey.

Experimental rigour

You use data, research, prototypes and controlled experiments to make decisions. You learn from negative results and can distinguish meaningful progress from activity.

You will also bring:

  1. At least five years of product management experience, preferably in consumer ecommerce, marketplaces or another digital product at scale.
  2. Experience owning a broad product area or customer journey, rather than only individual features.
  3. Experience defining product strategy or roadmaps for search, ranking, recommendations, personalisatio

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary 
 Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. 
 We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Product vision, grounded in real user needs 

 You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. 
 Market scoping and opportunity-spotting 

 Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. 
 Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

 Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. 
 The full lifecycle 

 From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. 
 The connective tissue across the company 

 When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. 
 
 The team you’ll join 
 You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. 
 
 Life at Bluerock 
 We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock. 
 
 
 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required. 

 Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field required. 

 A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations , on time and within budget. 

 Genuine ease operating cross-functionally . You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission. 

 An appetite for ambiguity and change : a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem. 

 Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification. 

 Excellent leadership and team management skills , with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams. 

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively. 

 Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment 

 
 Our hiring process 
 Hit the Apply button. 

 Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview 

 A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation. 

 An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS. 

 
Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Subsea)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager (Subsea) to lead multidisciplinary projects from initiation through delivery, with a strong focus on offshore, subsea or marine-related operations.
 
 In this role, you will manage complex technical projects involving internal teams, external partners and customers. You will be responsible for keeping projects on track, managing expectations, identifying risks early and ensuring successful delivery within scope, time and budget.
 
 This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong technical background, hands-on project management experience and exposure to offshore or subsea environments such as cable laying, geotechnical surveys, marine operations or related activities. You will join a growing scale-up environment where processes are still evolving, and where your experience can directly contribute to how we mature our project management approach.
 
 What you’ll do: 
 Lead multidisciplinary projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope and within budget.

 Act as the main point of contact for customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

 Manage projects related to offshore, subsea or marine operations, such as subsea cable installation, geotechnical monitoring, marine surveys or similar activities.

 Coordinate closely with R&D, engineering, production, commercial and other internal teams to ensure successful project execution.

 Translate technical requirements into clear project deliverables, timelines and actions.

 Identify project risks early and implement mitigation plans to protect delivery, quality and customer expectations.

 Monitor project progress, budget, planning, scope and key milestones.

 Support bid development, technical discussions and customer relationship management where needed.

 Contribute to improving project management processes, tools and ways of working in a scaling organization.

 Capture lessons learned, share knowledge and support others in building strong project delivery practices.

 
 What’s in it for you 
 Work on products that are deployed in real-world, high-impact environments, not just concepts or internal tools

 Operate in a fast-growing, international scale-up where you can truly influence how projects are run.

 Regular team activities and shared lunches throughout the week.

 
 What we’re looking for: 
 MSc degree in Engineering, Physics, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology or another relevant technical discipline.

 Around 5–8 years of relevant project management experience in a technical environment.

 Experience with offshore, subsea or marine-related projects, such as cable laying, geotechnical surveys, marine operations or similar.

 Strong planning, budgeting, risk management and project execution skills.

 Experience working with multidisciplinary technical teams.

 Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, partners and internal teams.

 Technical affinity and the ability to understand complex technologies and translate them into practical project deliverables.

 Comfortable working in a dynamic scale-up environment where priorities can shift and processes are still being developed.

 Fluent English communication skills; Dutch is a plus.

 
 You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.
