jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As we continue to scale, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager, who wants to drive real impact, taking products from concept to deployment.
 
 At Optics11, we build advanced sensing technology that helps protect what matters most, from critical offshore energy infrastructure to underwater security systems. Our solutions operate in complex, high-stakes environments where precision, reliability, and real-world performance are essential.
 
 In this role, you will work at the intersection of New Product Introduction (NPI) and Field Integration, ensuring that what is developed by engineering teams can successfully operate in real-world, often offshore environments. You will play a key role in bridging the gap between development and deployment. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role in a fast-moving scale-up, where not everything is fully defined. You will need to balance structure with pragmatism, make decisions with incomplete information, and keep projects moving despite changing priorities.
 
 What you will do 
 Lead end-to-end projects covering product delivery (hardware and software) and field integration, including offshore deployment

 Coordinate across engineering, operations, supply chain, and external partners to ensure smooth execution

 Translate ambiguous goals and requirements into clear, actionable plans

 Drive momentum and remove blockers in fast-moving, real-world environments

 Support bid preparation by building realistic timelines and execution strategies, even with limited information

 Identify gaps in ways of working and proactively improve processes across teams

 Enable a learning-oriented project environment by sharing best practices and coaching others

 Establish feedback loops between R&D and field teams to improve product and execution quality

 
 What’s in it for you 
 Work on products that are deployed in real-world, high-impact environments, not just concepts or internal tools

 Operate in a fast-growing, international scale-up where you can truly influence how projects are run

 Regular team activities and shared lunches throughout the week

 
 What we are looking for 
 5–8 years of project management experience in a technical environment

 MSc degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Physics, or a related field

 Hands-on experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) projects is essential

 Proven track record of delivering projects with real-world execution (not only planning)

 Comfortable combining structured planning with hands-on operational involvement

 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think in a structured way

 Experience with offshore or field deployment projects is a strong plus

 Able to make decisions and move forward with incomplete information

 Clear communicator who can align technical (R&D) and operational (field) teams

 
 You will thrive here if you 
 Enjoy seeing projects come to life in the real world, not just in plans or presentations

 Are comfortable navigating complexity, including on-site and offshore environments

 Prefer progress over perfection and know how to balance speed with quality

 Take ownership and proactively solve problems across both product and organization

 Can switch between strategic thinking and hands-on execution with ease

 
 This role might not be the best fit if you 
 Prefer fully defined scope and stable environments before getting started

 Rely heavily on rigid methodologies or extensive upfront planning

 Have worked mainly on large-scale, highly structured capital projects with limited exposure to fast-paced product environments

 Prefer to stay removed from operational or field-level challenges

 Find it difficult to make decisions or move forward with incomplete information

 
 You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

 We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â

jobs.title: Filtration Module Product Owner (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Product Development Ownership: You take ownership of developing innovative sorbent modules from approximately TRL3 to TRL6, optimizing trade-offs between product requirements, performance, manufacturability, and scalability. 

 
 Lifecycle Management: You lead the lifecycle management of new sorbent modules from TRL6 through product launch, service, and end-of-life, ensuring successful product deployment and long-term performance. 

 
 Validation & Industrialization: You coordinate the validation of new products through serial production delivery, initiating and driving all engineering, manufacturing, testing, and validation activities required for successful industrialization. 

 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work closely with in-house technology, development, and operations teams, as well as external collaborators, suppliers, and partners, to ensure seamless product development and delivery. 

 
 Prototype Fabrication & Testing: You support the fabrication and testing of prototypes, conducting experiments to validate design concepts, troubleshoot issues, and refine product performance. 

 
 Continuous Improvement: You drive the continuous improvement of sorbent modules by identifying opportunities to enhance product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost-effectiveness throughout the product lifecycle. 

 
 Educational Background & Experience: You hold an advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field and bring at least 5 years of industrial experience in product development, mechanical design, or design engineering. 

 
 Design & Engineering Expertise: You have hands-on experience with material selection, Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DfMA), Design for Maintainability (DfM), and Design for the Environment (DfE), combined with a basic understanding of chemical processes and associated energy and productivity trade-offs. 

 
 Project Leadership: You have a proven track record of successfully managing development projects from concept through implementation, coordinating engineering activities and ensuring delivery through collaboration with cross-functional teams and external vendors. 

 
 Innovation & Problem Solving: You bring strong creative problem-solving skills and a passion for advancing sustainable technologies, with a particular interest in contributing to early-stage R&D and product innovation. 

 
 Collaboration & Communication: You are an effective communicator who enjoys working across multidisciplinary teams, mentoring junior engineers, and managing IP-sensitive collaborations with third-party suppliers and partners. 

 
 Language Skills & Availability: You are fluent in English and comfortable operating in an international, collaborative engineering environment. You are available to work 80–100% and are willing to travel up to 10% as required. 

 
 Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together. 
 
 What we offer: 
 Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays. 

 Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country. 

 Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter. 

 Family Support: Inclusive parental leave. 

 Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth. 

 Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals. 

 
 Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
 Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.
 
 Your Mission 
 You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.
 As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.
 At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.
 You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.
 We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.
 
 Your Career Path in Project Management 
 This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.
 Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. 

 Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. 

 Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

 Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

 Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

 Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

 Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

 Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

 Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

 Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

 In addition, as a Senior Project Manager 
 Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

 Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

 Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

 What You'll Be Doing 

 You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 
 Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

 Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

 Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

 Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

 
 What You'll Need to Thrive 

 Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

 
 Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

 You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

 You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

 You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

 You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

 You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

 
 Next steps

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Product and Research Operations Manager, Voices
jobs.description:
About Cartesia 
 Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.
 We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.
 We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.
 
 The Role 
 We're looking for a Product and Research Operations Manager to run the operational backbone of Cartesia's Voice function - supporting voice production for customers, talent sourcing and logistics, and voice delivery for Go-To-Market and Customer Success. You'll work directly alongside our Voice Production Lead and Voice Library Lead, and provide hands-on support across their respective work-streams.
 Part of your time will go toward cross-functional ad-hoc operations, including supporting growth initiatives.
 Your Impact 
 Voice Production & Library - Support execution of voice production runs alongside the Voice Production Lead. Over time, you'll own day-to-day production and library health reporting, take on more locales and volume, and build automations to streamline the process.

 Sourcing & Talent logistics - Support voice sourcing alongside the Voice Library Lead. Build the systems to source, vet, and create voices for the voice library with voice acting talent as well as vendors.

 Customer Voice Delivery & Enablement - Own customer-facing voice engagements end to end, driving customers to be successful with our models. Drive voice-related GTM enablement.

 Ad-hoc Strategy and Growth Projects - Support ad-hoc strategy & operations work, including helping run events and marketing initiatives for Cartesia in London. Support Cartesia’s growth in international markets on a project by project basis.

 What We're Looking For 
 3 - 6 years as an operator at a high-growth tech startup or in strategy consulting (MBB or similar)

 High agency - a proactive self-starter who can operate autonomously to get things done in ambiguous environments

 Customer-facing chops, with the ability to drive conversations with executives

 Semi-technical - comfortable using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, etc to build lightweight systems, and understands core concepts of system design

 Genuine interest in operating with founder-level hunger, and real enthusiasm for voice and audio technology - you have opinions on it, not just interest

 What makes a strong candidate: 
 Experience in the AI industry, especially in AI Strategy and Operations or Product Operations roles

 A track record of going out of your way to get things done proactively

 Builds lightweight systems autonomously

 Detail-oriented under volume; maintains attention to detail even with large volume of tasks

 Credible in front of GTM teams and customers without needing a lead in the room

 
 More Details 
 🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.
 🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.
 🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.
 🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join us at NaturalMotion to help build a new, unannounced mobile free-to-play action game.

We embrace a hybrid work environment. Within this role, you would work 2 days per week in our London office and the remaining days at home.

What You’ll Do:

  • Work closely with a multi-disciplined team (Design, Art, Programming & Analytics) to design, scope and implement core features that result in an outstanding gameplay experience for our players and positively inflect metrics.
  • Own and manage the live operations schedule, ensuring best-in-class execution. Emphasis on attention to detail, proactive communication, and measurable results.
  • Support the leadership team in defining and iterating upon the game’s business strategy to build a robust product roadmap for development and post-launch live content.
  • Drive user and competitive research, champion the usage of core innovative game technology, and ensure that product decisions are based on in-depth data analysis and an understanding of the market.
  • Collaborate effectively across different business divisions, including release operations, user acquisition, legal, and other stakeholders, given the use of an established Take-Two IP.
  • Effectively champion product vision & strategy, monitor product progression through completion of milestones and partner with other parts of the organisation including Central Analytics and Product Marketing.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Measurement & Reporting
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

 Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

 This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.
 About the Role 
 You’ll own Measurement & Reporting: the product surface where Vibe turns campaign delivery into proof. Performance is why clients pick Vibe. Trusted, actionable measurement is why they stay and scale with us.
 Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Vibe explains and proves the impact of CTV advertising across every vertical. Your main focus will be ecom and CPG, with growing coverage of apps, local, and travel. The goal is to make CTV outcomes as trustworthy and actionable as search and social, so clients confidently move more budget to Vibe.
 You’ll work daily with Data Science, Data Platform, Engineering, and our client-facing teams (CS, Sales, TAM). With Walmart’s purchase data now part of the platform, measurement is becoming one of Vibe’s biggest differentiators.
 What You’ll Do 
 Reporting & Insight 
 Own advertiser-facing reporting, including dashboards, outcome metrics, and exports that make CTV performance clear to both technical and non-technical buyers.

 Turn raw performance data into benchmarks and insights clients can grasp at a glance.

 Attribution & Incrementality 
 Productize attribution and incrementality to a client-grade standard, not just an internal signal.

 Own integrations with the measurement tools clients already trust, such as MMPs, web/CAPI pixels, MMM, and third-party partners (e.g. Northbeam, Haus), so Vibe’s numbers hold up next to Meta and Google.

 Guarantee data accuracy, transparent methodology, and defensible results.

 Activation 
 Translate measurement into clear recommendations and next actions that drive spend decisions.

 Close the loop between proven outcomes and campaign optimization, powering the “more performance → more spend” flywheel.

 Partner with CS, Sales, and TAM to make measurement the core of how we retain and grow clients.

 Use SQL and log-level data to validate methodologies, size opportunities, and prioritize by impact.

 What You Need 
 5+ years in Product Management on performance AdTech, measurement/attribution, or analytics products.

 Strong grasp of digital measurement (attribution models, incrementality and causal testing, MMM) and of why click-based models break for CTV.

 Solid statistical literacy, including experimental design, holdouts, significance, and confidence intervals.

 A track record of shipping client-facing reporting or insight products, and of making complex data simple and trustworthy for marketers.

 Fluency with outcome KPIs across verticals and with the ecom/CPG performance stack.

 Hands-on SQL and data exploration, and you’re comfortable in technical, data-intensive environments.

 The ability to bridge technical measurement and business/GTM stakeholders.

 Why This Role 
 You’ll own the product domain that decides whether clients trust their Vibe spend, and whether they scale it.

 You’ll have a direct line to revenue, because measurement is Vibe’s main lever for retaining and growing clients.

 You’ll shape how an entire category proves CTV as a performance channel.

 You’ll have high autonomy and influence across functions, from data science to clients’ C-suite.

 Our Values 
 At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.
 You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.
 This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you

jobs.title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - France)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products
 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 
 One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 
 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 
 
 At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.
 Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .
 And we’re only just getting started! 
 
 Our Team
 We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.
 
 Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]
 • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 
 • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 
 • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 
 
 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]
 • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 
 
 Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]
 • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 
 
 Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]
 • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 
 • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 
 • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 
 • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 
 
 Your Role
 We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.
 You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.
 This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.
 Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.
 Here’s what you can expect:
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

 Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

 Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

 Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

 Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

 Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations.  What You'll Own

 Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

 Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

 Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

 Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

 Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

 Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Technical 
 Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

 Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

 Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

 Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

 
 Product & AI 
 Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

 Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

 Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

 Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

 Mindset

 Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

 Nice to have

jobs.title: Product Manager  H/F
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Innovation & Design

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.

 

Capco recherche des Product Managers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation.

Au sein de notre capability Tech, Product & Engineering, vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers.

Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants.

Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.

 

Vos responsabilités 

  • Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables.
  • Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue.
  • Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights.
  • Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit.
  • Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables.

Compétences et expériences désirées  

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil.
  • Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles.
  • Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile.
  • Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés.
  • Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. 

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

 

Nos marqueurs distinctifs :

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte
    Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure
    Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence

Nous encourageons chaque coéquipier et coéquipière à OSER et à prendre des responsabilités. Le droit à l’erreur fait partie du jeu ; il permet de grandir et d’évoluer ensemble.

Notre domaine digital PRISM "Pricing Referencing Inventory & Stock Management" a pour mission d'optimiser l'ensemble de notre supply chain mondiale pour garantir la disponibilité de nos produits au meilleur prix.

Nous recherchons un·e Senior Product Manager avec une forte dimension User experience et GenAI pour piloter le périmètre stratégique du Pricing Supply. Le produit que tu intégreras en co animation  a pour mission de piloter la marge grâce à un système de prix transverse. Il centralise plus de 15 outils, dont 12 transactions SAP, pour renforcer la compréhension des prix, garantir la cohérence des modifications tarifaires et sécuriser les marges.  

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

En tant que Senior PM Pricing, tu es le garant de la cohérence fonctionnelle et de la fiabilité des flux de prix cession et marge pour la supply chain. 

 

Tes responsabilités s'articulent autour de 4 piliers :

 

  • Vision et Stratégie : Tu définis la vision du périmètre produit et les axes stratégiques pour créer de la valeur pour les métiers de la Supply Chain. Tu intègres l’IA générative dans ta feuille de route (ex. automatisation des règles tarifaires, détection d'anomalies de marge) pour répondre aux usages de demain, tout en respectant les contraintes du calendrier de transition vers S/4HANA.

 

  • Design par intention : Tu garantis la conception du futur outil en l'intégrant de manière fluide dans l'expérience globale avec les autres produits de l'écosystème. Tu es garant de l'expérience utilisateur (UI) et du design des agents IA conversationnels/assistants intelligents de ton produit.

 

  • Pilotage du Delivery & Déploiement : Tu garanties la planification , roadmap et livraisons qualitatives des features de ton produit. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec les développeurs, les architectes et les intégrateurs pour sécuriser les mises en production internationales.

 

  • Governance & Gestion des parties prenantes : Tu assures le lien entre les experts métiers Retail/Supply et les contraintes techniques de l'ERP. Tu définis la gouvernance des prix cession/marge et simplifies les concepts complexes pour aligner l'ensemble des équipes vers un objectif commun de performance.

 

  • Suivi des KPIs: Tableaux de bord et rapports pour monitorer la santé et l’adoption du produit l'engagement des utilisateurs et identifier les axes d'amélioration.

 

  • Animation PM & Leadership : Tu assures l'animation fonctionnelle des Product Managers prestataires et tu mentores les PMs internes afin d'élever les compétences globales autour des pratiques produit et de l'intégration de la GenAI.

 

CE QUE TU APPORTES

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Als Senior Projectmanager (Program Manager) binnen het People & Process Office van CloudNation ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van complexe cloud- en AI-programma’s. Je zorgt voor voorspelbare uitvoering, sterke governance en meetbare bedrijfsresultaten. In nauwe samenwerking met de Customer Lead, die verantwoordelijk is voor klantstrategie en waardecreatie, draag jij de verantwoordelijkheid voor delivery, planning, risicomanagement en operationele excellentie over teams, projecten en platforms heen.
 Je stimuleert schaalbare dienstverlening, ondersteunt strategische initiatieven zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE) en benut AI om programmamanagement en uitvoering verder te versterken.
 Succes wordt gemeten aan de hand van betrouwbare oplevering, effectief stakeholdermanagement, transparantie, risicobeheersing en continue verbetering binnen cloud- en AI-trajecten.
 Leid strategische cloud- en AI-programma’s en zorg voor succesvolle levering, sterke governance en aantoonbare bedrijfsresultaten.

 Vertaal klantdoelstellingen naar uitvoerbare plannen, roadmaps, budgetten en leveringsprioriteiten.

 Bouw en onderhoud vertrouwde relaties met klant stakeholders, waaronder senior management en directieleden.

 Stimuleer AI-gedreven delivery door Responsible AI, compliance, kwaliteit en operationele excellentie te integreren in de uitvoering.

 Werk nauw samen met Customer Leads om strategie, uitvoering en governance op elkaar af te stemmen.

 Signaleer groeikansen en stimuleer de adoptie van strategische proposities van CloudNation, zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).

 Zorg voor heldere rapportages, effectief risicomanagement en continue verbetering binnen programma’s en teams.

 
 Gekoppeld aan het 6D Delivery Model 
 Discover 
Werk samen met Business Relationship Managers en klanten om doelstellingen, drijfveren en uitdagingen te begrijpen, inclusief de gebieden waar AI aantoonbare toegevoegde waarde kan creëren.
 Define 
Stel duidelijke programmadoelstellingen, scope, tijdlijnen en succescriteria vast, afgestemd op strategische prioriteiten en, voor AI-initiatieven, op data-volwassenheid en compliance-eisen.
 Design 
Begeleid teams bij het vormgeven van oplossingen met behulp van frameworks zoals Azure CAF & Enterprise-Scale en het AWS Well-Architected Framework, waarbij Responsible AI waar relevant wordt geïntegreerd.
 Develop 
Stuur op een hoogwaardige en flexibele uitvoering (Agile of Waterfall), inclusief beoordelingsmomenten en kwaliteitscontroles voor AI/ML-ontwikkeltrajecten.
 Deploy 
Leid de implementatie en overdracht van opgeleverde resultaten, waaronder CCoE-initiatieven en productiegereedheid (inclusief MLOps voor AI-oplossingen).
 Continuous Delivery 
Ondersteun klanten bij het operationaliseren van resultaten, draag samen met de Customer Lead verantwoordelijkheid voor governance en behoud het overzicht op continue verbetering en waardecreatie.
 
 
 
 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het leiden van complexe cloudtrajecten, inclusief het aansturen van meerdere teams, budgetbeheer en stakeholdermanagement op senior niveau.

 Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van complexe programma’s met meerdere teams, waaronder de implementatie van proposities zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).

 Sterke ervaring met delivery management in multicloudomgevingen (Azure en AWS), inclusief Azure CAF / Enterprise-Scale en het AWS Well-Architected Framework.

 Ervaring met AI- en/of dataprogramma’s, inclusief Responsible AI, compliance (zoals de EU AI Act) en de MLOps-levenscyclus.

 Werkt aantoonbaar AI-ondersteund, bijvoorbeeld met AI-agents zoals Claude of Claude Code, en stimuleert deze werkwijze binnen teams.

 Sterk in verwachtingenmanagement en in staat structuur en rust te brengen in complexe, veranderende omgevingen.

 Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden tot en met C-level, met sterke beheersing van risico’s, afhankelijkheden en budgetten.

 Kan de administratieve aspecten van programmamanagement zelfstandig beheren, waaronder projectinrichting, planning en facturatie.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Design - Security
jobs.description:
The Datadog Security design team (K9 Design, as we lovingly call it) is hiring a senior product design manager to lead design across our security products. This is a chance to shape an industry-leading experience for a new kind of Datadog user: security practitioners who need to catch threats where they start, stop them when they land, and shut down exposures before they turn into something worse.

You'll lead a team of designers at various stages of their careers across cloud, code and data security, turning an overwhelming amount of signal into something a security team can act on. The goal: build the security product people want to spend their day in. You'll own the design, push for excellence, and partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to get there.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What you’ll do

  • Lead design direction across your team's products, and hold the bar for design excellence end to end: interactions, visual detail, consistency and cohesion.
  • You're in the work. Run critiques, give direct and useful feedback, and push the team toward bolder, more opinionated solutions rather than safe ones.
  • Coach and grow designers across our Paris, Madrid and New York offices, helping each of them do the best work of their careers.
  • Help define a security design system built on top of Datadog's existing components, with the security practitioner's workflows in mind.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to evolve cross-platform thinking, shape roadmaps, and to set how the three disciplines work together day to day.
  • Take accountability for the product and business outcomes your team's design work influences.
  • Bring AI fluency to how your team works, from how design gets explored and validated to how it gets shipped.

Who you are

  • 10+ years in design, including experience leading and growing high-performing teams.
  • A design leader first: a user advocate with a sharp eye for detail, strong taste and the willingness to get into the work and give direct feedback.
  • A track record of leveling up a team's output, with before-and-after examples of how your leadership transformed the design of a product.
  • You've led complex products or features: a zero-to-one launch, a reimagining of something established, or both.
  • A strong communicator who collaborates effectively with executive and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Able to demonstrate AI fluency, either in your own work or in how you've led teams through it.
  • Comfortable navigating the technical complexity of modern software development and cloud infrastructure.
  • Ideally: security domain experience, or a portfolio of information-dense, data-rich interfaces. Industry-leading work on complex B2B, B2C or consumer products counts for just as much here.

Benefits and Growth

  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities for internal mobility
  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
  • Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

LI-Hybrid

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - Netherlands)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products
 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 
 One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 
 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 
 
 At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.
 Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .
 And we’re only just getting started! 
 
 Our Team
 We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.
 
 Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]
 • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 
 • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 
 • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 
 
 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]
 • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 
 
 Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]
 • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 
 
 Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]
 • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 
 • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 
 • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 
 • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 
 
 Your Role
 We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.
 You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.
 This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.
 Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.
 Here’s what you can expect:
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

 Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

 Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

 Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

 Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

 Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

 Incident follow-through and continuous improvement . Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

 
 Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub .

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Mobile (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About Patronus 
 Patronus develops smart emergency call technology that gives seniors greater safety and independence in their daily lives. More than 25,000 people already rely on us. As a Berlin-based healthcare startup backed by financially strong investors, we’re growing rapidly—and in this role, you’ll help drive that growth.
 As (Senior) Product Manager, Mobile (f/m/x) , you’ll join our product management team—which is currently growing to a team of four—and report directly to the Team Lead Product Management. You’ll take on operational product responsibility for iOS, Android, and our smartwatch app . You’ll work with Engineering, QA, and relevant stakeholders to further develop the mobile experience. What defines us as a team: rapid iterations , a high degree of autonomy , and a consistent focus on the user .
 
 What you'll do 
 Mobile Product Ownership: Own the iOS, Android, and smartwatch apps, including the roadmap

 Discovery & Requirements: Translate user research and customer interviews into user stories and a prioritized backlog

 Data-Driven Decisions: Analyze user behavior, KPIs, and user feedback; derive and validate hypotheses

 Growth & Retention: Focus on DAU/MAU, retention, churn, and activation; use A/B testing as a growth driver

 Processes & UX: Design efficient workflows and deliver an outstanding mobile experience across all three platforms, using AI tools for rapid prototyping and UI generation

 Quality & Support: Test new features hands-on, support QA and work closely with our customer support team

 
 What you bring 
 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager for mobile apps (iOS and Android); experience with smartwatches or other wearables is a plus

 Experience in a fast-paced environment with quick execution, shifting priorities and real room to shape the product

 A data-driven approach: you base decisions on app KPIs, user feedback and analytics

 Strong stakeholder management skills and a hands-on mentality

 First experience with UX/UI design (Figma) and prototyping

 Curiosity about AI and, ideally, experience with tools like Hotjar, Miro, Mixpanel and Jira

 Fluent English; German skills are a big plus

 
 What we offer 

 ⚖️ Fair from the Start: We’ll give you our best possible offer right away—we start with the number that other companies only present at the end of negotiations.

 🏢 Work Location: Work from home up to 2 days a week, plus an air-conditioned office with a view of the Spree in the heart of Friedrichshain

 📚 Growth: A €500 annual learning & development budget, a clear career framework, and 360° feedback to support your professional growth

jobs.title: Head of Product Compliance (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. 
 Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.
 Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.
 Help us see what's possible. Join us. 
 Your Role 
 Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Product, you will drive product quality management and regulatory compliance for Orbem’s cutting-edge systems across the EU, US, and other upcoming markets. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting complex hardware, software, and AI capabilities with international safety and industry standards. Leading and scaling the product compliance team, you will ensure our products meet global market standards and internal quality requirements fast.
 
 Your Day-to-Day 
 Enable Global Product Impact: Own compliance roadmaps for international market access, securing NRTL approvals and achieving CE marking through the Machinery Regulation and EMC Directive.

 Lead and Scale the Team: Mentor and grow the product compliance team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, fast delivery, and strong ownership.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product development disciplines, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Legal experts to embed compliance and quality management seamlessly into our product lifecycle.

 Close the Conformity Loop: Own the path from field and production nonconformances through root-cause analysis and CAPA into updated risk assessments, technical files, and design changes — so what we learn on site changes what we build.

 Stakeholder Enablement: Translate complex regulatory frameworks into clear guidance, facilitating alignment and smooth execution across multidisciplinary teams.

 Agile Framework Optimization: Maintain structured compliance guidelines while adapting processes to support the fluid pace of a fast-growing scaleup environment. Champion system validation processes to ensure product reliability.

 Own Regulated Product Documentation: Take accountability for operator, installation, and maintenance manuals, safety markings, and translations as conformity deliverables in their own right, leading the technical writers who produce them.

 
 
 Your Experience and Skills 
 You have 10 + years experience in compliance and quality management and proven experience in a leadership role, ideally within an agile scale-up or high-growth tech environment.

 Experience overseeing complex systems that combine hardware, software, and AI, ideally involving special machinery or automation equipment.

 You have run nonconformance and CAPA processes for complex electromechanical products, with hands-on root-cause practice (8D, FMEA, fault tree or equivalent) and a track record of field failures actually changing designs.

 Broad knowledge of international product compliance frameworks, specifically UL508A and NFPA79 approvals, and CE marking under the Machinery Regulation and EMC Directive.

 You have defined quality and compliance requirements in stage-gate processes, and built Design for Compliance, and Design for Quality principles in the product development process.

 Track record of building, mentoring, and scaling technical teams.

 Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills with a collaborative leadership mindset.

 You are comfortable defining a common framework for acceptance criteria and verification evidence, including factory and site acceptance testing, calibration, and measurement traceability.
  

 
 What Makes You Stand Out 
 Direct domain experience with industrial automation systems in the food processing or agricultural sectors.

 Academic background in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

 
 Fit to Our Values 
 We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

 We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

 We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

 
 What We Offer 
 International Environment: 
 Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

 Comprehensive Benefits: 
 Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

Deine Rolle bei uns

 Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Product Marketing Manager (w/m/d) zur Verstärkung des Workist Marketing-Teams. Als unser erster Product Marketing Manager (PMM) baust Du die Funktion von Beginn an mit auf und übernimmst die Verantwortung für sie. 

 Diese Position ist ideal für Dich, wenn du bereits erste Erfahrung im Product Marketing sammeln konntest und mit Deiner Erfahrung das Product Marketing bei Workist mit aufbauen und ownen möchtest. In dieser Rolle wirst Du viel Kontakt mit den Product, Sales und Customer Success Teams haben und direkt an den VP Marketing berichten. 

 Deine Aufgaben

 
 Positionierung & Messaging für die Workist Produkte entwickeln und über alle Plattformen und Kanäle hinweg konsistent kommunizieren

 Plane neue Produkt Launches in enger Abstimmung mit Product, Sales und CS

 Versorge die GTM-Teams mit überzeugenden Materialien wie Sales Decks, Demo-Skripten, Battle Cards und Produktvideos

 Führe Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen sowie Buyer & User Research durch, teile dein Wissen mit den anderen Teams und erarbeite einen Competitive Edge für Workist

 
 Dein Profil

 
 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Product Marketing, idealerweise im Bereich AI/B2B SaaS

 Du hast die erfolgreiche Markteinführung neuer Produkte/Features geleitet, nicht nur begleitet

 Du begeisterst dich für gutes Storytelling, kannst komplexe Produkte klar und überzeugend erklären

 Du arbeitest analytisch und bemisst deinen Erfolg anhand von Daten

 Du arbeitest gerne an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product, Sales und CS und kannst gut koordinieren und planen

 Du erstellst gerne ansprechende Inhalte in unterschiedlichsten Medienformaten und bist sicher im Umgang mit den neuesten KI-Tools

 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (nativ) und Englisch (weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus)

 
 Unsere Benefits & Kultur

 
 WorKi Tower: Unser hippes Office im Herzen der Stadt über 6 Etagen lädt dich zum professionellen Arbeiten an einem ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz ein und lässt dir Freiraum für deine Kreativität. Unsere eigene Workist-Lounge wartet mit einer gemütlichen Atmosphäre inkl. Kaffee, Drinks und einem Vitaminkorb auf kurze oder längere Kreativpausen auf dich. Spiele Tischtennis, Dart oder Nintendo, um deinen Kopf frei zu bekommen und um dich mit anderen Teams auszutauschen.

 Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestaltet deinen Arbeitstag mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. Du hast wichtige Termine am Morgen oder Abend? Kein Problem, profitiere von der Arbeitszeit-Flexibilität.

 Office, Remote & Workation: Du entscheidest selbst und hast auch hier die flexible Wahl zwischen hippem Office oder Remote von deinem Lieblingsort aus! Wir stellen dir frei, 4 Wochen im Jahr auch aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten. Deine State-of-the-Art Hardware wird dich auf deinen Wegen begleiten!

 Come-Together: Let’s play together - let’s celebrate together! Lass den Arbeitsalltag bei einem kühlen Getränk in unserer Lounge ausklingen oder genieße die Zeit mit deinen Kollegen beim Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unseren quarterly Teamevents.

jobs.title: Product Owner *in Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns

 Mit 75 Mitarbeitenden ist die IT&I GmbH ein in Berlin-Mitte ansässiges Unternehmen für Softwareentwicklung und -beratung. Wir entwickeln und betreiben maßgeschneiderte Softwareanwendungen für die Energiewirtschaft. Dabei unterstützen wir unsere Kunden bei der Umsetzung der IT-Anforderungen in einem durch die Energiewende geprägten dynamischen Umfeld mit agilen Methoden. 

 Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine*n Product Owner *in Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d) .

 Das machst du bei uns

 
 Du übernimmst die fachliche und organisatorische Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle IT-Projekte im Umfeld moderner Cloud- und Softwarelösungen

 Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Auftraggebern zusammen, verstehst ihre fachlichen Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in umsetzbare Lösungen für die Entwicklungsteams

 Du priorisierst Anforderungen, definierst User Stories und begleitest die Umsetzung als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich, Auftraggeber und Entwicklung

 Du steuerst die Entwicklung von serviceorientierten und API-basierten Anwendungen und begleitest die Transformation bestehender On-Premises-Lösungen hin zu skalierbaren Cloud-Architekturen

 Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit aller Projektbeteiligten, triffst fachliche Entscheidungen und sorgst für Transparenz hinsichtlich Fortschritt, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten

 Du planst und organisierst Tests, Qualitätssicherungsmaßnahmen sowie fachliche und technische Abnahmen

 Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und Systeme, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Auftraggeber nachhaltige Lösungen

 Du wertest Projekt- und Betriebsdaten aus, erstellst Reports und leitest fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen für Stakeholder und Projektteams ab

 
 Das bringst du idealerweise mit

jobs.title: Marketing & Growth Project Manager - Meals
jobs.description:
En bref

Chez Picnic, nos clients sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. En tant que Meals Business Manager, tu seras le moteur de l'un de nos principaux leviers de croissance : les recettes. Avec un catalogue de plus de 1000 recettes et un planificateur de repas unique, notre ambition est claire : s'intégrer durablement dans le quotidien et les habitudes culinaires des Français.

Pour y parvenir, tu collaboreras avec des développeurs de recettes, des analystes et des créatifs pour faire rayonner notre fonctionnalité recettes sur tous les canaux : in-app, paid social, newsletters, et bien d'autres. Ta mission : transformer chaque interaction en une invitation à cuisiner avec Picnic.

Tes missions

  • Planifier et exécuter des campagnes 360° : Concevoir et piloter de A à Z des campagnes cross-canal ambitieuses (comme notre campagne de Noël) pour offrir des expériences clients cohérentes, créatives et engageantes.
  • Gérer les communications quotidiennes : Créer, planifier et optimiser l'envoi de newsletters, notifications push et autres communications régulières pour informer nos clients, nourrir leur inspiration culinaire et générer du trafic sur l'app.
  • Valoriser nos fonctionnalités et notre assortiment : Mettre en avant les atouts de l'app Picnic et de notre offre produit avec créativité, pour inspirer et guider nos clients à chaque étape de leur parcours.
  • Piloter la performance par la donnée : Concevoir et mener des A/B tests, analyser les résultats et traduire les insights en actions concrètes pour améliorer en continu la performance de nos campagnes.
  • Contribuer à la croissance business : Identifier et mettre en place des actions ciblées et autonomes pour générer une demande supplémentaire et atteindre nos objectifs hebdomadaires.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Picnic : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Meals internationale et les créatrices de recettes en local, ainsi qu'avec les analystes et créatifs, pour co-construire des campagnes à fort impact.

À propos de toi

 

  • Tu es diplômé·e d’un Master en Marketing, Business, Communication ou domaine connexe.
  • Tu as entre 3 et 4 ans d’expérience à temps plein dans un rôle lié au growth marketing, à l’activation client ou à la gestion de campagnes digitales multicanales. Tu as déjà travaillé sur la promotion de fonctionnalités produit, de parcours in-app ou d’expériences digitales, avec une forte orientation acquisition et activation client.
  • Tu as évolué dans un environnement exigeant et hands-on : startup, scale-up ou organisation avec un fort niveau d’autonomie et de responsabilité. Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements rapides et opérationnels, où les décisions ont un impact visible immédiatement.
  • Tu as déjà piloté des campagnes ou projets créatifs impliquant de multiples stakeholders (Design, Copy, Business, Tech, agences, etc.) et sais faire avancer des sujets complexes jusqu’à une exécution irréprochable.
  • Tu combines créativité et esprit analytique, et sais naturellement transformer des insights en actions concrètes. Tu es à l’aise avec Excel et capable de prendre des décisions basées sur des données. 
  • Le français est ta langue maternelle et tu maîtrises parfaitement l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Tu as une forte affinité pour l'univers de l'alimentaire et le goût des bonnes choses. Tu aimes mettre en valeur de façon authentique les bons produits, les producteurs et le terroir.

 

Avantages Picnic

🍴 Restauration 

Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux

jobs.title: Product Owner BakerWare
jobs.description:
De verbindende schakel zijn tussen klanten, business en softwareontwikkeling én bijdragen aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen die gemeenten, belastingsamenwerkingen en waterschappen helpen om hun dienstverlening continu te verbeteren? Het kan als Product Owner bij BakerWare. In deze rol vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die écht werken. Je adviseert klanten, werkt samen met ontwikkelteams en begeleidt de ontwikkeling van gebruiksvriendelijke software die zichtbaar verschil maakt in de dagelijkse praktijk. Maak werk van deze mogelijkheden. 
 
 Wat jij doet 
 Als Product Owner ben jij de verbindende factor tussen onze klanten en het ontwikkelteam. Je begrijpt de uitdagingen van onze klanten, brengt behoeften in kaart en vertaalt deze naar slimme softwareoplossingen. Geen klant en geen vraagstuk is hetzelfde. Bij de ene klant ligt een plan al klaar en bij de andere klant help jij om de behoefte en mogelijkheden te ontdekken. Jij stelt de juiste vragen, denkt mee over processen en zoekt samen met de klant naar de oplossing die écht waarde toevoegt. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces. Samen met het team zorg je ervoor dat klantwensen worden vertaald naar concrete functionaliteiten en kwalitatieve software. Daarbij combineer je adviesvaardigheden, proceskennis en affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling. 
 
 Wat doe je nog meer? 
 Je adviseert klanten over procesverbetering en digitale oplossingen. 

 Je analyseert klantbehoeften en vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen voor het ontwikkelteam. 

 Je stelt samen met het team user stories op en beheert de backlog. 

 Je draagt bij aan sprintplanningen en begeleidt ontwikkeltrajecten. 

 Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, toepasbaarheid en gebruiksvriendelijkheid van oplossingen. 

 Je werkt nauw samen met klanten, developers, productteams en andere stakeholders. 

 Je signaleert commerciële kansen en denkt mee over de verdere ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening. 
 

 Dit krijg je 
 Bij BakerWare kun je als Product Owner rekenen op: 
 Een brutosalaris vanaf €3.510,00 tot €5.040,00 per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring 

 Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt 

 Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden 

 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd 

 Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering 

 Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak 

 Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag 

 Een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer van € 0,23 netto per kilometer óf een NS Businesscard 

 Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken 

 Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt 

 Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën? 
 

 Dit breng je mee 
 Je bent enthousiast, nieuwsgierig en denkt graag in mogelijkheden. Je krijgt energie van complexe vraagstukken, klantcontact en het creëren van slimme oplossingen. Je bent communicatief sterk, overtuigend en weet verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden. 
 Daarnaast breng je mee: 
 HBO werk- en denkniveau. 

 Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie als Business Consultant, Product Owner, Functioneel Consultant of een vergelijkbare rol. 

 Kennis van bedrijfsprocessen en ervaring met procesoptimalisatie. 

 Sterke adviesvaardigheden en het vermogen om klantbehoeften helder in kaart te brengen. 

 Een goed analytisch vermogen en een methodische manier van werken. 

 Affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling en digitale dienstverlening. 

 Een commerciële instelling en oog voor nieuwe kansen. 

 Een proactieve houding, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om snel te schakelen. 

 Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift. 

 Je voelt je thuis in een organisatie waar ruimte is voor eigen initiatief, waar samenwerking centraal staat en waar je samen met klanten en collega’s werkt aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen. 
 
 Werken bij BakerWare 
 BakerWare is dé softwarespecialist voor Gemeenten, Belastingsamenwerkingen en Waterschappen! We zijn een gedreven en enthousiaste groep mensen met jarenlange kennis en ervaring die in staat is om de nieuwste ontwikkelingen en vraagstukken om te zetten naar innovatieve en gebruiksvriendelijke software oplossingen. Deze rol vervullen we door ons op te stellen als partner bij de doorlopende ontwikkelingsprocessen van onze klanten.
